settings.intro: Join a community shaping the future of higher education in Andhra Pradesh. The application takes about 10–15 minutes. Fields marked * are mandatory, and your progress is saved on this device as you go.
settings.closedMessage: We are not accepting applications at the moment. Please check back soon.
settings.applicantEmailMessage: Thank you for your interest in joining RVS University. We have received your application and our recruitment team will review your profile. If your profile matches our requirements, we will contact you for the next steps.
settings.declarationText: I hereby declare that all the information furnished in this application is true, complete and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief. I understand that any false or misleading information may lead to rejection of my application or termination of service.
settings.successMessage: Your application has been submitted successfully. A copy has been sent to your email address.
